docs.title: Core concept:
docs.text:
Fundamentally, IoT is about data. It's a network which is "made up of many things"

(a practical example: sensors on a bridge sending live data about its structural integrity)

docs.text:
• Explain:

    • how data provides value to business and society;
    • the benefits of automation;
    • the need for enhanced security;
  • Basic programming for IoT;
  • Discover opportunities provided by digital transformation.
